prompt:
Create a new KFB claymation ink blob sheet, The Other School Bells. Use the original reference PNGs for the established organic full-body ink monster morphology and modeling. Exactly six whole independent standalone dark charcoal-plum goo figures, three columns and two rows, landscape 1536×1024 true transparent PNG. Every face is sculpted directly into its continuous organic blob. Think six different compact asymmetrical drips, rounded pears, commas and irregular splats, as varied as the original family. Maintain each individual silhouette, with natural soft little lobes at the sides and bottom, sometimes no distinct foot shape. A short round or tapered bottom is welcome. Do not use a standard flared base, wide flat skirt, common lobe row, humanoid chest or cut-off bust. Clothing is just a small removable accessory and props sit close to the side or belly with the lower body visible. Thick sculpted dark lids, white sclera, red iris and black pupil. Soft satin clay, sparse broad hand modeling marks, distinct moods, tiny ink hands. No inherited costume, wing or eyepatch, scenery, floor, shadow, frame or text beyond specified prop marks. Preserve generous transparent separation and exterior margin. Muted blue, peach, sage and warm grey, quiet desk and care props.
Row-major roles:
1. Female-read school librarian. tall curved drop, one alert eye, knowing little smile. Key cue: small stack of two books and a short bookmark with a tassel.
2. Male-read school social worker. wide low rounded blob, warm relaxed eyes. Key cue: one smooth listening pebble and a tiny open notebook.
3. Male-read school first-aid helper. round lopsided blob, concerned soft brows. Key cue: small plain first-aid pouch with a simple plus and one folded bandage.
4. Male-read school IT technician. lean squared blob, skeptical gaze and flat mouth. Key cue: one oversized detachable plug and little cable coil.
5. Female-read after-school supervisor. upright reverse comma, patient smile and lifted eyebrows. Key cue: small tray of colored puzzle pieces and one short pencil.
6. Male-read learning support assistant. squat scalloped splat, gentle attentive gaze. Key cue: three rounded stair-shaped counting blocks.
Each actor has a distinct complete compact ink contour from crown to lower edge and one clean readable subject or role prop.
